name: Downloaded Maps Manager: start only when needed
description: Changes MapsBroker from Automatic (Delayed) to Manual.
mechanism: ChangeServiceConfig on 'MapsBroker'. The Maps app still starts the service on demand.
benefit: One fewer service started after sign-in.
drawback: Offline map updates only happen while the Maps app is in use.
recommendedFor: PCs that don't use offline maps.
evidence: Service purpose documented by Microsoft. Measured gain is small; mainly a start-up/background reduction.

name: Distributed Link Tracking Client: Manual
description: Changes TrkWks from Automatic to Manual.
mechanism: ChangeServiceConfig on 'TrkWks', which keeps links to files on NTFS volumes working when files move between computers in a domain.
benefit: One fewer always-running service on home PCs.
drawback: Shortcuts to files moved across NTFS volumes/network shares may not auto-repair.
recommendedFor: Home PCs not joined to a domain.

name: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry: Disabled
description: Stops the DiagTrack service that uploads diagnostic data.
mechanism: ChangeServiceConfig on 'DiagTrack' to Disabled. Windows security features and updates do not depend on it.
drawback: Diagnostic data and some feedback/Insider features stop working; Microsoft cannot use crash/usage data to diagnose problems on this PC.
recommendedFor: Privacy-focused users who accept losing diagnostic features.
evidence: Service documented in 'Configure Windows diagnostic data'. Not a security component. Disabling is reversible here.

name: SysMain (Superfetch): Disabled (SSD systems, expert)
description: Stops SysMain from pre-loading frequently used apps into memory.
benefit: Can reduce disk and CPU activity after boot on some systems.
drawback: Apps may launch slightly slower; SysMain also manages memory compression heuristics. On HDD systems it is beneficial and should stay on.
recommendedFor: Experts troubleshooting high disk activity on SSD systems.
evidence: Microsoft recommends leaving SysMain enabled. Benefit for gaming is unproven; benchmark before and after.

name: Windows Search indexer: Manual (low-end, expert)
description: Stops the indexer from running continuously in the background.
benefit: Removes background indexing disk/CPU activity on slow systems.
drawback: Start, Explorer and Outlook search become much slower and may miss results.
recommendedFor: Very low-end HDD PCs that rarely search.
evidence: Documented service. Indexing is throttled when the user is active, so gaming benefit is usually small.

name: Program Compatibility Assistant: Manual
description: Changes PcaSvc from Automatic to Manual.
benefit: One fewer background service monitoring program launches.
drawback: Windows no longer offers compatibility fixes for old installers/programs automatically.
recommendedFor: PCs that run only current software.
